name: Portofino
aero_highlight: Retractable hardtop with air-curtain front vents
description: Ferrari's front-engined V8 grand tourer replacing the California T, combining a stiffer lightweight aluminium chassis with a retractable hardtop.

name: 360 Modena
description: The first production Ferrari constructed entirely from aluminium space-frame architecture, powered by a high-revving flat-plane crank V8.

name: Jesko Attack
aero_highlight: Top-mounted active boomerang wing (1400 kg downforce)
description: Track-honed variant of the Jesko engineered for maximum cornering downforce via a massive active dual-plane rear wing and deep front splitter.

name: Tourbillon
aero_highlight: Full-length Venturi diffuser & active rear wing
description: Bugatti's post-W16 flagship pairing a Cosworth-developed 9000-rpm naturally aspirated V16 with three electric motors and a Swiss watchmaker-inspired analog cluster.

name: Chimera
aero_highlight: Agera RS aero package with Jesko powertrain
description: A bespoke one-off commission built for FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem, grafting the Jesko's 1600 hp engine and simulated gated-manual shift system into an Agera RS.

name: Venom F5 Revolution Coupe
aero_highlight: Full-width adjustable carbon rear wing & dive planes
description: Track-focused evolution of the Venom F5 featuring revised cooling, stiffer suspension geometry, and high-downforce aero tuned for apex speed.

name: Centenario LP770-4
aero_highlight: Extending active rear wing & rear-wheel steering
description: Built to celebrate Ferruccio Lamborghini's 100th birthday, debuting rear-wheel steering and dramatic carbon-fibre bodywork over the Aventador SV platform.

name: W1
aero_highlight: Active Long Tail rear wing extending 300 mm
description: Successor to the F1 and P1, utilizing ground-effect aerodynamics and an active long-tail wing to generate 1000 kg of downforce in Race mode.

name: Zonda F
description: Named after Juan Manuel Fangio, refining the Zonda with a 7.3-litre Mercedes-AMG V12, gated six-speed manual gearbox, and obsessive titanium and carbon craftsmanship.

name: B2
description: Russia's first mid-engine supercar, pairing dramatic aggressive styling with a lightweight aluminium spaceframe and a Cosworth-tuned turbocharged V6.

name: Reventon Roadster
description: An ultra-rare open-top tribute to stealth fighter jets powered by the Murcielago LP 670-4 SuperVeloce V12, limited to just 15 examples worldwide.
